description: This file defines the SugarNewsDashlet class, a customization of a Dashlet within SuiteCRM. It sets templates and a default URL for a news dashlet in the dashboard, extending the iFrameDashlet class.

classes.name: SugarNewsDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class extending iFrameDashlet to display SuiteCRM news via an iframe, with specified templates and default URL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for SugarNewsDashlet, sets the title and initializes the dashlet with provided id and options.
